The '''Republic scout speeder''' was a heavily armed [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army's]] [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] on [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] missions. It was used during<ref name="CW Toy" /> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>

The [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was equipped with interchangeable weapons, including two [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two light [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], all of which were metallic in [[Color/Legends|color]] and fired blue blaster bolts. A [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] station equipped with a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] was located at the speeder's rear, which was surrounded by two [[Turbine/Legends|turbine]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. Its viewscreen frame could be lifted up to allow for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to sit inside. Furthermore, the repulsorcraft had a red and white color scheme, with a white [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundel]] painted on its red viewscreen frame. During the Clone Wars, an Advanced Recon Force [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] adorned with red markings utilized the speeder on<ref name="CW Toy" /> the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Felucia">{{SWE|locations|felucia|Felucia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic scout speeder was released by [[Hasbro]] in [[2011]] as part of the second wave of the "Shadows of the Dark Side" toys, which in turn were a part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' toy line]].<ref name="CW Toy" />
